paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu and Sena-hime had followed utterly different paths in life; what she yearned for and what he sought had nothing in common. Ieyasu was growing accustomed to viewing events in the light of the world and the course of human life, while Sena-hime remained fixated on her personal happiness. If she could have obtained what she wanted, that would have been one thing; but what she pursued was a castle in the air, and her nature would never allow her simply to laugh off the disappointment.
